plugins.name: cm-workspace
plugins.description: Change-management working tools. Two skills: an RFP-to-proposal deck generator that plans a bid against the client's stated requirements and evaluation criteria, and a communications generator that drafts change comms for a requested channel and routes each to the tool that builds it — Word for emails and articles, PowerPoint for briefing decks, Canva for newsletters and banners, and production specs for video. Both write from a shared curated knowledge bank and audit their output for coverage and content provenance before anything is produced.
